recipe.name: Example study: PK dataset for a one-compartment model
recipe.description: Concentrations, dosing and demographics of a made-up study, merged into a NONMEM dataset.

steps.note: Concentrations are the backbone: one row per sample.
Dose records go in the same table as the samples.
Hours since the first dose of each subject.
Demographics by subject; one subject has none.
Missing baseline values get the population median, and are flagged.
A dose comes before a sample taken at the same time.
LLOQ of the assay is 5 ng/mL.
Cockcroft-Gault in mL/min, creatinine converted from µmol/L.
Daily doses become ADDL and II.

findings.title: Subjects appear in more than one block
findings.detail: NONMEM treats each change of ID as a new subject: 1 appear in several places. Sort by ID and TIME.

findings.title: TIME goes backwards within a subject
findings.detail: Records must be in time order within each subject. Sort by ID and TIME.

findings.title: Observation records without a concentration
findings.detail: EVID = 0 and MDV = 0 need a DV. Set MDV = 1 for a missing sample, or remove the row.

findings.title: CMT is not a positive whole number
findings.detail: Give every record a compartment.

findings.title: Invalid RATE
findings.detail: RATE is a positive infusion rate, 0, −1 (rate in the model) or −2 (duration in the model).

findings.title: ADDL is not a non-negative whole number
ADDL without an interval
findings.detail: ADDL > 0 needs II > 0.

findings.title: Some column names are not valid NONMEM names
findings.detail: NONMEM names start with a letter, hold letters, digits and underscores, and have at most 20 characters; "DATE", "Visit Date". Rename them, or drop the columns in $INPUT.

findings.title: Negative TIME
findings.detail: Allowed by NONMEM, but often a mistake (a sample before the first dose, or a wrong reference date).

findings.title: MDV is 0 on a dose record
findings.detail: Dose records are not observations: MDV should be 1.

findings.title: Dose records carry a DV
findings.detail: A DV on a dose row is ignored only if MDV = 1.

findings.title: Negative concentrations
findings.detail: Not possible for a concentration; it may be a baseline-corrected value.

findings.title: Concentrations equal to 0
findings.detail: Often a BLQ record written as 0 (the residual error model cannot fit 0 on a log scale). Apply a BLQ method.

findings.title: Duplicate rows
findings.detail: Identical rows (a repeated dose or sample is counted twice).

findings.title: WT: 3 missing values (30.0% of rows)
findings.detail: NONMEM reads an empty covariate as 0. Fill them (Fill missing covariate values) or exclude the subjects.

findings.title: Text columns
findings.detail: SEX, DATE, Visit Date hold text. NONMEM cannot read text: they are written as SEX=DROP, DATE=DROP, Visit Date=DROP in $INPUT, or recode them to numbers.

findings.title: 1 subject(s) with a single observation
findings.detail: Fine for a population model, but they contribute little to between-subject variability.
